summary.en: He (victim) was meeting the suspect, he was killed when he was apologizing to the culprit. While they are having their private conversation in Mt. Saijo. He apologizes to the culprit, that he musn't do it again, and he must live freely. But, the culprit made the opposite situation, what he did to him is he slashed him to his neck and died, also that head was used onto their crime to carry it all out. They made Kansuke Yamato as their culprit on this case, because he act strangely.
